Archive a Salary Rule

User manual · English · 9 steps
Learn how to archive a salary rule that should no longer be applied, without losing the payslips that already used it.

1. Open Payroll

Open the Payroll app.

2. Configuration menu

Open the Configuration menu.

3. Rules

Click Rules.

4. Find the salary rule

Type the name of the salary rule and press Enter.

5. Open the group

Click the group that contains the rule to open it.

6. Select it

Tick the box in front of the salary rule.

7. Actions

Click Actions.

8. Archive

Click Archive.

9. Confirm

Click Archive in the window to confirm.
